boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's fs_command.c, 0x0205c5e4..0x0205c7c4: 2 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. pret's pokediamond FS_command.c defines exactly two functions, FSi_ReleaseCommand and then FSi_TranslateCommand, and both are here, each identified by body. FSi_TranslateCommand indexes fsi_default_command, the table of FS_COMMAND handlers that fs_command_default.c below it fills.

Order: mwccarm emits deferred bodies in reverse. The ROM run is pret's source order reversed: FSi_TranslateCommand lowest, FSi_ReleaseCommand highest. FSi_TranslateCommand (0x1a4) follows pokediamond's C statement for statement; FSi_ReleaseCommand (0x3c) is pret's body without the OS_DisableInterrupts/OS_RestoreInterrupts pair, which this older SDK does not have, and it clears only BUSY|CANCEL|SYNC|ASYNC (0xf), where pret's mask also covers its OPERATING bit.
BOTTOM EDGE: FSi_CloseFileCommand and the rest of fs_command_default.c (arm9/FS_CommandDefault) end at 0x0205c5e4.
TOP EDGE: FS_SetArchiveProc (0x0205c7c4) starts FS_archive.c (arm9/FS_Archive), which pret keeps in its own file.
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/FS_CommandDefault: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
Both symbols were renamed from their func_ names to the SDK names in this change (symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence).

Text-only. fsi_default_command stays in .data with its owner unassigned. FSFile and FSArchive are this SDK's layouts and stay local to the file: the other FS shards declare their own partial spellings.
